exact code and decided it is safe, and here is the reason. The key is a fingerprint of the matched TEXT,
so EDITING that code invalidates the verdict and the hit resurfaces -- which is the point.
Rationale for each rule id lives in docs/SECURITY_PATTERN_SWEEP_2026-07.md.
Never clear a hit here without recording why in that document.

This is the H2->Postgres whole-database promotion (Move 9 A4): it copies every row of every business table from source to target. A tenant predicate here would silently drop every other tenant's data during a migration. REG-94 triage, Move 11 Wave 0.1. (Re-added 2026-08-01 after an accidental git checkout -- lost the fingerprint though the code and reasoning are unchanged.)
